correctness.rationale: Exact independent series-parallel recursion, k-phase telescoping complement-product identity, sharp factored cubic maximum h(x)<=32/27, equality classification, and monotone fixed-point iteration prove all quantifiers. The rational witness is exact; finite checker ran 437 assertions. The code is not used to prove infinite convergence. The arithmetic-mean corollary follows from AM–GM applied to shortcut nonoccupation rates.

value.rationale: Scale-dependent shortcuts are a natural perturbation of the classic hierarchical percolation model. The exact sharp geometry-mean criterion forces limiting two-root connection for arbitrary period and proves an explicit phase reversal despite equal arithmetic mean. This is a motivated structural boundary, not a small numerical increase or routine tabulation. The AM–GM corollary additionally proves that any nonconstant modulation at the homogeneous critical average removes the nonunit limiting root connection.
